user.title: NASCAR Race Center
user.description: Offline demonstration uses handmade sample data and makes no network requests. NASCAR CF is experimental and requires your confirmation of applicable data-use permission. This setting does not grant permission. Live behavior and anonymous endpoint access remain unverified. Polling slows automatically away from a current race; shorter intervals are not guaranteed to be permitted.

error.invalid_series: Select at least one of series 1, 2 or 3.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number from 300 to 3600 seconds.
